status_definitions.VERIFIED: Every criterion of the stated item evidenced; all ten mandatory conditions plus exact authorization are required to fit
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some criterion evidence verified, but whole condition not satisfied
status_definitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Missing authentic facts or an actual authorized researcher/joint decision outside this automated verification; this does not imply a mandatory adviser or third-party custodian signature.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_TECHNICAL: Necessary verified software check currently fails or is absent

conditions.acceptance_criterion: Exact release/acquisition/source-custody evidence plus researcher source acceptance
conditions.evidence: source-retrieval.json; documentary-checks.json; prior source pointer identities; source-snapshot.json: genuine official opaque acquisition and exact archive SHA-256; release-comparison.json verifies source members and bundled documentation against the frozen archive; source_manifest.csv; researcher-authority-matrix.json
conditions.external_requirement: No blanket external custodian/adviser signoff for ordinary source capture. Source class-definition facts and an actual researcher-recorded prospective scope remain incomplete.

conditions.acceptance_criterion: Authoritative UCI-327 release-specific Result numeric class definition
conditions.evidence: uci-metadata.json:data.variables[30].description=null; authenticated feature DOCX has no Result definition; label-source-checks.json; release-comparison.json: actual source header declares codes only; release document contains no Result token; result-semantics-evidence.json: original-author papers lack a release-bound codebook; 2016/2018 secondary publications assert opposite mappings
conditions.external_requirement: Obtain a release-specific UCI/creator Result definition or clarification; neither secondary majority nor researcher approval resolves contradictory facts.

conditions.acceptance_criterion: Authenticated original-record through transformation to cleaned-development identity, with complete attrition receipts
conditions.evidence: lineage-recovery.json; historical recipe only; prospective-protocol.json is unapproved; ml.uci_reconstruction: synthetic-tested source-byte-to-ledger construction; genuine payload execution remains blocked; execution-authorization-analysis.json; execution-authorization-request.md
conditions.external_requirement: Researchers may record a consistent prospective preparation design; need exact permitted original-row scope and authentic source facts. No authenticated historical bridge was found.
